name.en: Ohio State Route 7 — the river road
name.zh: 俄亥俄 7 号州道（沿河公路）

tagline.en: Ohio's longest state route, pinned between the river and the hill
tagline.zh: 俄亥俄最长的州道，被夹在河与山之间

start.zh: 亨廷顿对岸切萨皮克附近的 US 52

end.en: I-90 at Conneaut on Lake Erie
end.zh: 伊利湖畔康尼奥特的 I-90

en: SR 7 is the longest state route in Ohio and for most of its length it is the Ohio River road. From Chesapeake it runs upstream for about 235 miles with the river almost continuously in view, through Gallipolis, Pomeroy, Marietta, Bellaire, Bridgeport, Steubenville and East Liverpool, shadowed on the far bank by West Virginia Route 2.

It is a working road through a worked-over landscape: river towns built on glass, pottery, steel and coal, floodwalls with murals on them, and the remains of industry being demolished or repurposed. The Ohio River Scenic Byway follows it from East Liverpool south.

North of East Liverpool the character breaks. SR 7 runs with US 30 and SR 11 to Rogers, then turns north on its own towards Youngstown, crosses the Ohio Turnpike and I-80, and finishes at I-90 in Conneaut on Lake Erie — a completely different Ohio from the one it started in.
zh: SR 7 是俄亥俄最长的州道，其大部分路段就是俄亥俄河公路。自切萨皮克起，它逆流而上约 235 英里，河景几乎不曾中断，途经加利波利斯、波默罗伊、玛丽埃塔、贝莱尔、布里奇波特、斯托本维尔与东利物浦，对岸始终有西弗吉尼亚 2 号公路相伴。
这是一条穿越被反复开发过的地貌的工作用路：建立在玻璃、陶瓷、钢铁与煤炭之上的河畔小镇，绘有壁画的防洪墙，以及正被拆除或改作他用的工业遗存。俄亥俄河风景道自东利物浦向南沿其而行。
东利物浦以北，性格断裂。SR 7 与 US 30、SR 11 共线至罗杰斯，随后独自北转驶向扬斯敦，跨越俄亥俄收费公路与 I-80，最终在伊利湖畔的康尼奥特接入 I-90——与它出发时完全是两个俄亥俄。

en: The hazard on the river section is above the road, not on it. ODOT built SR 7 into the side of a hill for mile after mile, and the hillsides above it fail.

The worst case is at Mingo Junction in Jefferson County, where a rockfall in March 2020 closed lanes that stayed closed for nearly five years. The remediation involved weekly blasting to excavate the slope, and in July 2024 one of those blasts brought down more material than expected and put significant rockfall across both lanes; the road reopened about twenty-six hours later, once the debris was cleared and the barrier wall replaced.

The four-lane cross-section was restored in September 2025, with new pavement and a new barrier wall between the hillside and the roadway. ODOT District 11 has been plain about what comes next: a geotechnical engineer monitors the sites continuously, there are still deficient hillsides, and more projects like it are likely.
zh: 沿河路段的危险来自路的上方，而不是路面。俄亥俄交通部把 SR 7 一英里接一英里地开凿在山腰上，而上方的山坡会失稳。
最严重的一处在杰斐逊县的明戈章克申：2020 年 3 月的一次落石封闭了数条车道，而这些车道一封就将近五年。治理工程需要每周爆破以开挖边坡；2024 年 7 月，其中一次爆破崩落的方量超出预期，大量落石覆盖两条车道；在清除碎石并更换护栏墙后，道路约二十六小时后重新开放。
四车道断面于 2025 年 9 月恢复，配有新路面以及山坡与路面之间的新护栏墙。俄亥俄交通部第 11 区对接下来的情况说得很直白：地质工程师持续监测这些点位，仍有不稳定的坡体，类似工程很可能还会再有。

en: The Ohio River Scenic Byway is the reason to drive the southern two-thirds. ODOT's corridor management plan puts the Ohio portion at 452 miles across fourteen counties, thirteen of them Appalachian, using SR 7 together with US 50 and US 52; the full national byway continues west into Indiana and Illinois for 943 miles.

SR 7 carries the eastern end of that, from East Liverpool south through Wellsville, St. Clairsville, Bridgeport and Bellaire. The attractions are the ones the river produced — the Museum of Ceramics at East Liverpool, the Wellsville flood wall murals and river museum, the Imperial Glass Museum and the Great Stone Viaduct at Bellaire.

Allow for construction. Between the rockfall work at Mingo Junction and the pedestrian bridge at Martins Ferry, the Steubenville-to-Bellaire stretch has been under some form of work for years, and ODOT's own statement is that hillside projects on this corridor will continue.
zh: 俄亥俄河风景道是驾车走南边三分之二路段的理由。俄亥俄交通部的走廊管理计划将俄亥俄段定为横跨十四个县（其中十三个属阿巴拉契亚地区）的 452 英里，由 SR 7 与 US 50、US 52 共同组成；完整的国家风景道继续西行进入印第安纳与伊利诺伊，总长 943 英里。
SR 7 承担其东端，自东利物浦向南经韦尔斯维尔、圣克莱斯维尔、布里奇波特与贝莱尔。沿途景点都是这条河催生的——东利物浦的陶瓷博物馆、韦尔斯维尔的防洪墙壁画与河流博物馆、贝莱尔的帝国玻璃博物馆与大石高架桥。
要把施工算进去。从明戈章克申的落石治理到马丁斯费里的人行天桥，斯托本维尔至贝莱尔一段多年来一直处于某种施工状态，而俄亥俄交通部自己的说法是，这条走廊上的山坡工程还会继续。

why.en: ODOT publishes its road inventory as a GIS dataset rather than as a per-route certified total, and no state-published length for SR 7 could be verified this session.
why.zh: 俄亥俄交通部以 GIS 数据集形式发布道路清查资料，而非按路线的认证总里程；本次未能查证到该州公布的 SR 7 长度。
